title: Crispy Danmuji Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, featuring crispy danmuji and a zesty twist.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
2. Cook the danmuji slices until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
3. Meanwhile, warm the taco shells according to package instructions.
4. Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of crispy danmuji into each shell.
5. Top the danmuji with shredded lettuce, a spoonful of zesty taco sauce, a sprinkle of queso fresco, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
6. Serve immediately and garnish with sliced radishes and a dollop of sour cream.
